title: The Wrong Key
setting: A clothes shop in town and the front door of the uncle's small house.

characters.name: Ben
characters.look: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts)

characters.name: Lily
characters.look: Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots)

sentences.en: Ben and Lily spend the day with their uncle.
sentences.zh: 本和莉莉跟叔叔一起过了一天。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) and Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots) walk down a sunny street holding hands with their uncle (a tall man with glasses and a green shirt).
sentences.narration: Ben and Lily walk down a sunny street holding hands with their uncle.

sentence_targets.en: a parent's brother or an aunt's husband

sentences.en: The jeans Ben wears are too short now.
sentences.zh: 本穿的牛仔裤现在太短了。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts), wearing old jeans instead of his shorts, looks down at the jeans, which end high above his ankles.
sentences.narration: Ben, wearing old jeans instead of his shorts, looks down at the jeans, which end high above his ankles.

sentence_targets.en: Trousers made from strong cotton cloth, usually denim.
Having little length, height, or duration.
to have clothes, jewellery, or accessories on your body

sentences.en: So their uncle buys him a new pair.
sentences.zh: 于是叔叔给他买了一条新的。
sentences.scene_prompt: In a clothes shop, their uncle (a tall man with glasses and a green shirt) pays for a folded pair of blue jeans while Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) smiles beside him.
sentences.narration: In a clothes shop, their uncle pays for a folded pair of blue jeans while Ben smiles beside him.

sentence_targets.en: Two matching things, or one object with two connected parts.
a parent's brother or an aunt's husband
to obtain something by paying money for it

sentences.en: At home, their uncle has a big problem.
sentences.zh: 到家后，叔叔遇到了一个大问题。
sentences.scene_prompt: their uncle (a tall man with glasses and a green shirt) stands at the closed front door of his small house, frowning and scratching his head, with Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) and Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots) beside him.
sentences.draw_note: Shows the uncle worried at a closed door; what the problem is only becomes clear in the next picture.
sentences.narration: their uncle stands at the closed front door of his small house, frowning and scratching his head, with Ben and Lily beside him.

sentence_targets.en: a parent's brother or an aunt's husband
a situation that causes difficulty and needs a solution

sentences.en: But his key is wrong for the door.
sentences.zh: 可是他的钥匙跟这扇门不配。
sentences.scene_prompt: Close-up: their uncle (a tall man with glasses and a green shirt) tries to push a big key that clearly does not fit into the small lock of the front door.
sentences.narration: Close-up: their uncle tries to push a big key that clearly does not fit into the small lock of the front door.

sentence_targets.en: An object shaped to open or close a particular lock.

sentences.en: Lily speaks up: “Look above the door!”
sentences.zh: 莉莉大声说：“看门的上方！”
sentences.scene_prompt: Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots) points up excitedly at a small key lying on the frame above the front door, her mouth open as she calls out.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Lily calling out and pointing at a key above the door; her exact words can't be shown.
sentences.narration: Lily points up excitedly at a small key lying on the frame above the front door, her mouth open as she calls out.

sentence_targets.en: In a higher position than something else.
Use your voice to say words or communicate with someone.

sentences.en: They all go into the house and feel better.
sentences.zh: 他们都走进屋里，感觉好多了。
sentences.scene_prompt: their uncle (a tall man with glasses and a green shirt), Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) and Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots) walk happily through the open front door into the house.
sentences.narration: their uncle, Ben and Lily walk happily through the open front door into the house.

sentence_targets.en: Of higher quality or more suitable than something else.

sentences.scene_prompt: Inside the house, Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts), now wearing his new blue jeans, proudly shows them to Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots).
sentences.narration: Inside the house, Ben, now wearing his new blue jeans, proudly shows them to Lily.
